title: Boundary defect of multiplication by a smooth function: |∂T(ψω) − T(ψ dω)| ≤ ∫‖Dψ‖|ω| dμ_T (Simon 4.11 with (**) and R5)
statement: For all P, m ∈ ℕ, every U ⊆ ℝ^P, every T ∈ D_{m+1}(U), every Borel measure μ on ℝ^P and v : ℝ^P → Λ_{m+1}(ℝ^P) (NVector) with IsMeasureRepresentation T μ v and |v(x)(α)| ≤ covectorEuclideanNorm(α) for all x and all (m+1)-covectors α, every ω ∈ D^m(U) and every C^∞ function ψ : ℝ^P → ℝ: there are test forms η₁ ∈ D^m(U) and η₂ ∈ D^{m+1}(U) with η₁(x) = ψ(x)ω(x) and η₂(x) = ψ(x)·dω(x) for all x (dω = exteriorDerivative ω) such that, in [0,∞], ofReal|∂T(η₁) − T(η₂)| ≤ ∫⁻ ‖Dψ(x)‖·ofReal(covectorEuclideanNorm(ω(x))) dμ(x), where Dψ(x) = fderiv ℝ ψ x.
lean_statement: ∀ (P m : ℕ) (U : Set (Eucl P)) (T : GeometricCurrentOn U (m + 1)) (μ : Measure (Eucl P)) (v : Eucl P → NVector (Eucl P) (m + 1)), IsMeasureRepresentation T μ v → (∀ (x : Eucl P) (α : Covector (Eucl P) (m + 1)), |v x α| ≤ covectorEuclideanNorm α) → ∀ (ω : TestFormOn U m) (ψ : Eucl P → ℝ), ContDiff ℝ ((⊤ : ℕ∞) : WithTop ℕ∞) ψ → ∃ (η₁ : TestFormOn U m) (η₂ : TestFormOn U (m + 1)), (∀ x, (η₁ : DifferentialForm (Eucl P) m) x = ψ x • (ω : DifferentialForm (Eucl P) m) x) ∧ (∀ x, (η₂ : DifferentialForm (Eucl P) (m + 1)) x = ψ x • exteriorDerivative (ω : DifferentialForm (Eucl P) m) x) ∧ ENNReal.ofReal |T.boundary η₁ - T η₂| ≤ ∫⁻ x, (‖fderiv ℝ ψ x‖₊ : ℝ≥0∞) * ENNReal.ofReal (covectorEuclideanNorm ((ω : DifferentialForm (Eucl P) m) x)) ∂μ
